verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a hosted API service with API keys, so a documented per-key rate limit is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack states any requests-per-second or requests-per-minute limit, or describes throttling behavior. The API-key controls on record (IP allowlists, locking a key to certain endpoints or formats) are a different feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
